metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.2 · 2012 · The Hunger Games
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen voluntarily takes her younger sister's place in the Hunger Games: a televised competition in which two teenagers from each of the twelve Districts of Panem are chosen at random to fight to the death.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.5 · 2013 · The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark become targets of the Capitol after their victory in the 74th Hunger Games sparks a rebellion in the Districts of Panem.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.6 · 2014 · The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen is in District 13 after she shatters the games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin and the advice of her trusted friends, Katniss spreads her wings as she fights to save Peeta and a nation moved by her...

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.6 · 2015 · The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
metas.description: Katniss and a team of rebels from District 13 prepare for the final battle that will decide the fate of Panem.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.6 · 2023 · The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
metas.description: Coriolanus Snow mentors and develops feelings for the female District 12 tribute during the 10th Hunger Games.
